memory_candidates.content: Plan-authoring pattern for record-amendment tasks (a research-only task whose implementation phases are text amendments to prior artifacts): a verification criterion of the form 'each anchor grep still matches exactly once after the edit' is UNSATISFIABLE for any anchor the phase's own task list mandates replacing, and an implementer who takes it literally must substitute a check mid-phase. The fix is an explicit per-anchor disposition table in the phase body -- each anchor tagged KEPT (fixed-string count stays 1) or REPLACED (count goes to 0, with a named deliberately-kept half that must still count 1) -- measured with grep -cF at plan time and re-measured immediately before editing. The same table doubles as the correction-target existence check (never name an amendment target without confirming it exists) and as the Scope Hypothesis's hunk count. Pairs with the fact that specs/** paths return the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel from suite_selection_select, so the honest covering check for such a phase is validate-artifact.sh on the amended artifact plus a diff read-through, never a gate subset.
